narration.text: Still struggling with slow video edits? Today, we pit Descript against DaVinci Resolve! Which AI video editor offers the best speed advantage?

First up, AI Transcription! Descript offers built-in, fast, and highly accurate transcription. It even removes filler words automatically. DaVinci Resolve, however, has no native AI transcription and needs third-party tools. No contest here! Descript takes the round!

Next, Text-Based Editing! Descript lets you edit video simply by editing the text transcript. This is revolutionary for cutting drafts! DaVinci Resolve sticks to traditional timeline editing, with no text-based features. That one hurts! Descript wins again!

Finally, Performance! Descript uses cloud-based processing, which is fast for many tasks, but can depend on your internet. DaVinci Resolve boasts highly optimised desktop performance, but it does demand powerful hardware. This round goes to DaVinci Resolve!

So, the verdict is in! Descript wins for pure speed in draft and transcript-based editing, but DaVinci Resolve remains the king for professional colour grading and effects. Which tool would you pick for your next project? Let us know in the comments! And follow for daily AI battles!
